Class MeshCoreCompanionFrames

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.protocol.meshcore.MeshCoreCompanionFrames
public final class MeshCoreCompanionFrames extends Object
Utilities and constants for MeshCore Companion Protocol packets.

These packets are used the same way over BLE RX/TX characteristics and raw TCP/Serial byte-stream endpoints.

    • hex

    • nodeIdFromPublicKeyHex

      public static String nodeIdFromPublicKeyHex(String publicKeyHex)
      Returns a short MeshCore node id for a public key.

      The full public key remains in runtime state; the UI and database receive a stable short identifier, mc:<12 hex>, compatible with existing chat-field constraints.

      Parameters:
      publicKeyHex - full or partial public key in HEX
      Returns:
      node id in the mc:abcdef123456 form, or null

    • publicKeyPrefixFromNodeId

      public static byte[] publicKeyPrefixFromNodeId(String nodeId)
      Returns the first 6 public-key bytes from a MeshCore node id.
      Parameters:
      nodeId - node id in the mc:<12 hex> form
      Returns:
      6-byte public-key prefix, or an empty array

    • hexToBytes

      public static byte[] hexToBytes(String hex)
      Decodes a HEX string into bytes.
      Parameters:
      hex - HEX string without separators
      Returns:
      byte array; invalid input produces an empty array
